subject: general
question: In which of the following places did the first session of the Indian National Congress take place?
solution:
The Correct Answer is **__Bombay__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The First Session of the Indian National Congress was held in **Bombay.**
 
• The Session took place from 28 December to 31 December **1885**.
 
• The Session was attended by almost 72 delegates from all over the country. **Dadabhai Naoroji, Justice M. G. Ranade, Behramji Malabari** were among them.
 
• The Session was held on the initiative of retired civil service officer **Allan Octavian Hume**.
